content.comment_body: Just before the release of [product_name] [version_no], [company_name] released an updated demo version. Unfortunately, it is still at [version_no] and not the expected [version_no]. [product_name] Demo ([version_no])

analysis.insight_summary: A user expresses disappointment that the demo release provided by [company_name] is not the most recent version, highlighting a mismatch between demo availability and full product updates. The key concern centers on the timing and version of demo releases, suggesting users feel frustrated by delays or lack of access to new features in trial versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the latest demo version to be available simultaneously with the main product update, rather than receiving an earlier version.
